parts:
Pozdrav vsem,

Glede na pripombe sem pripravil vprašalnik o željah in kapacitetah srečanj za Rkoholike. Ideja je, da dobimo dober pregled želja, idej in kapacitet in glede na to organiziramo nadaljnja srečanja. Upam, da bomo na ta način prebrodili to začetno opotekanje in naredili bodoča srečanja čim bolj koristna in prijetna.

Vprašalnik lahko izpolnite tukaj.
(http://spreadsheets.google.com/viewform?formkey=dHUxcXMzYUVTZklvRm9BSTVoNlpBVEE6MA)

Odgovore lahko pogledate tukaj,
(http://spreadsheets.google.com/pub?key=tu1qs3aESfIoFoAI5h6ZATA&output=html)

LP,

Tomaž
-------------------

Hello everyone,

According to the comments I prepared a questionnaire about wishes and capacities for the Rkoholiki meetings. The idea is to get a good overview of wishes, ideas and capacities and to organize the future meetings accordingly. I hope that in this manner we'll overcome these first stumbles and make the future meetings as useful and pleasant as possible.

You can fill the questionnaire here.
(http://spreadsheets.google.com/viewform?formkey=dHUxcXMzYUVTZklvRm9BSTVoNlpBVEE6MA)

You can take a look at the responses here.
(http://spreadsheets.google.com/pub?key=tu1qs3aESfIoFoAI5h6ZATA&output=html)

LP,

Tomaž
